questions.question_text: A student calculates $8 \times 600$ as $480$. Which correction is accurate?

options.text: $8 \times 600=480$ because only one zero is ever attached.
options.why: Counted one zero by habit instead of using both zeros in $600$.

options.text: $8 \times 600=48$ because the zeros do not affect the product.
options.why: Multiplied only the non-zero digits and discarded the place value.

options.text: $8 \times 600=608$ because multiplication means adding the numbers.
options.why: Added $600$ and $8$ instead of multiplying the factors.
